brief: Evaluate an array of values (statements) while a condition is true
description:
This creates a new structured block with a new nested variable scope.

This function will evaluate an array of values (statements) while a condition is true. The condition is tested at the beginning of the loop. If the condition is false for the first iteration, the loop returns a null value. See the related functions 'break', 'continue', 'return' and 'throw'.

parameters.description: While this condition is true, the loop will continue. This is evaluated in the loop's scope.
parameters.name: condition

parameters.description: This is an array of values (statements) that are evaluated for each iteration of the loop. Each value in body is evaluated in order until the end of the list or until a 'break', 'continue', 'return' or 'throw' function is encountered.
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: Optional loop label for break/continue Identifier (issue #62).
parameters.name: label

returns.description: Does not complete. Nested assignment still writes the running result.
